answer: Progress along a spiral is accepted only at a vertex that binds the previous turn to a sonnet this key alone can open. Publishing the same sonnet from a second key resolves to the same vertex, and the duplicate is discarded. An operator who copies one session into n keys still has one opening line, so the copies collapse onto one vertex instead of n rewards. Waiting on many keys at once does not open a second spiral, because a later turn is valid only when it extends the same vertex chain.
